scene: The crank unlocks three secret transit doors along the observatory wall.
picture: A flat side view along a level stone floor inside the planetarium. On the far left, an open bay reveals a yellow delivery truck. Left of centre sits the girl in her teal hoodie and purple wheelchair. In the centre, an illuminated glass elevator waits open. On the far right, a striped steam train sits on polished rails.
shown: a yellow delivery truck idling by a bay door on the far left
a glowing glass elevator with doors open in the centre
a striped steam train puffing sweet smoke on the far right
